description: E22 long-document sources at seq 32768 (SmolLM3 = Llama-3 vocabulary). Whole documents are tokenized and CHUNKED into consecutive 32k rows ([BOS] chunk [EOS]) instead of truncated, so every PG-19 book contributes all of its ~3 rows and long PDFs are kept in full; rows shorter than min_tokens are dropped so the tier is genuinely long. Reuses the NAS raw archive (--raw_dir with per-source symlinks + --keep_raw). Combined at manifest level with the short fluency tier (fineweb_edu, stack_edu_py from the 8k tree) and the E18b keyed-recall rows via scripts/write_manifest_variant.py; weights here are placeholders (token-share targets set in the merged manifest).

long_context_policy.notes: pg19_chunked rows are 32k except a book's last chunk; finepdfs_long keeps PDFs >= 4096 tokens only.

sources.name: pg19_chunked
sources.notes: Book-length narrative; ~24k books in 23 shards (the archived set). Decontaminate PG-19 test/validation before any published number.

sources.name: finepdfs_long
sources.notes: Long coherent PDFs only (>= 4096 tokens after tokenization); 16 archived shards.
